set.price_text: AED 5 with Emirates ID; AED 10 for visitors from outside the UAE; AED 8 via tour operators. Worshippers free. Book online
set.hours_text: Sat–Thu 9:00 AM–8:30 PM; Fri 9:00–11:30 AM and 2:30–8:30 PM
set.description: The UAE's largest mosque with 82 domes, white marble courtyards and the world's largest hand-knotted carpet. Visitors need a ticket booked online on the official website; worshippers enter free. Free guided cultural tours run daily. Modest dress required.
